summary: NuRAN Wireless Inc., a British Columbia-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 15, 2026 press release and an at-the-market offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC. The ATM permits sales of common shares with an aggregate offering price up to US$50,000,000 under the company's existing Form F-10 shelf registration (File No. 333-298508), which covers up to US$100,000,000 of securities. Canadian counsel TCJ LLP and Farris LLP provided legality opinions; no price per share, premium, or closing date was stated. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch dilution and share overhang from at-the-market sales.
